items.name: Cuboss Open - Uppsala 2026
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjA1MDYwLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--ba01789f78e1cb5afc0fff3b42388bb78a8bf771/cuboss-open-2026-logo.png) Varmt välkomna till Cuboss Open 2026! Detta blir en väldigt speciell tävling, där WCA-grenarna blandas med en mängd olika specialgrenar. Dessutom kommer det ske väldigt mycket roliga grejer i lokalen. Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter samt oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet. Vi ber er läsa igenom alla flikar på denna sida eftersom de innehåller mycket värdefull information. **OBS:** Det kommer filmas och tas bilder i tävlingslokalen under tävlingens gång. Ta kontakt med arrangörsteamet så snart som möjligt om du inte vill synas i dessa. -- Welcome to Cuboss Open 2026! This will be a very special competition, where the WCA events are mixed with a variety of special events. In addition, there will be a lot of other fun happenings at the venue. Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience. We ask you to read through all the tabs on this page as they contain very valuable information. **N.B:** There will be filming and photography in the competition venue during the competition. Please contact the organizing team as soon as possible if you do not want to be seen in these. [![](https://cuboss.se/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/cuboss-svekub-loggor.png)](https://svekub.se/om_oss/svekub-cuboss/)

Freut euch auf ein länderübergreifendes Event mit spannenden Solves und einer tollen Community. Wir freuen uns auf euch! **Français:** Chers speedcubers, Nous avons le plaisir de vous inviter à la Dreiländereck Open, les 24 et 25 octobre 2026 ! Un bel événement transfrontalier vous attend, avec des solves passionnants et une superbe communauté. Nous avons hâte de vous accueillir ! **English** Dear Speedcubers, We warmly invite you to the Dreiländereck Open on October 24–25, 2026! This competition is a collaboration between speedcubing communities from France, Germany, and Switzerland. Look forward to an international event with exciting solves and a fantastic community. We’re excited to see you there!

items.name: Salonica Autumn Open 2026
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjExMDYzLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--2b39acc8afc2f42f3a6da807026b51e138f0abec/image.png) **SALONICA AUTUMN OPEN 2026** Το ετήσιο ραντεβού μας στη Θεσσαλονίκη επιστρέφει! Στις 24 και 25 Οκτωβρίου 2026, όλοι οι Cubers συναντιόμαστε ξανά για έναν μεγάλο διήμερο διαγωνισμό γεμάτο ταχύτητα, συναγωνισμό και όμορφες στιγμές. Το Salonica Autumn Open 2026 θα αποτελέσει ταυτόχρονα τον δεύτερο διαγωνισμό της **GREEK CUBING LEAGUE**! Τα μέλη της GREEK CUBING LEAGUE (https://greekcubingleague.gr) θα έχουν **επιστροφή 7€** στην κάρτα τους, αμέσως μόλις οριστικοποιηθεί η εγγραφή τους κατά την ολοκλήρωση των εγγράφων. Ετοιμαστείτε για ακόμη ένα αξέχαστο cubing Σαββατοκύριακο! Πάρτε τους κύβους σας, ετοιμαστείτε, διαβάστε τους κανόνες και ελάτε στην γιορτή του cubing! Παρακαλoύμε διαβάστε αναλυτικά τις επόμενες σελίδες για να βρείτε όλες τις απαραίτητες πληροφορίες. Σημείωση: Για να θεωρείται ολοκληρωμένη μία εγγραφή πρέπει να ολοκληρωθεί το registration στη σελίδα του διαγωνισμού στην WCA **KAI** να γίνει και η πληρωμή του αντιτίμου συμμετοχής με χρήση της τραπεζικής σας κάρτας μέσω της πλατφόρμας πληρωμών stripe που χρησιμοποιεί η WCA, όπως περιγράφεται στις καρτέλες δίπλα. Δείτε αυτά τα βίντεο για να είστε ετοιμασμένοι: [Εγγραφή στη WCA, σε επίσημο διαγωνισμό και πολλά ακόμα. Οδηγός για πρωτάρηδες.](https://youtu.be/RS768gK0Vrg) [Πώς να είσαι κριτής σε διαγωνισμό κύβων.](https://youtu.be/x5KaXXoh7XI) **SALONICA AUTUMN OPEN 2026** Our annual meetup in Thessaloniki is back! On October 24 and 25, 2026, all Cubers gather once again for a major two-day competition packed with speed, friendly rivalry, and great moments. Salonica Autumn Open 2026 will also serve as the second competition of the **GREEK CUBING LEAGUE**! Members of the GREEK CUBING LEAGUE (https://greekcubingleague.gr) will receive **a €7 refund** back to their card as soon as their registration is finalized upon completing the registration process. Get ready for another unforgettable cubing weekend! Grab your cubes, gear up, read the rules, and join the cubing celebration! Please read the following pages carefully to find all the necessary information. Note: For a registration to be considered complete, you must complete the registration process on the competition's WCA page AND pay the participation fee using your bank card through the Stripe payment platform used by the WCA, as described in the adjacent tabs.

items.name: Sedgefield Coastal Challenge 2026
items.information: **Welcome to Sedgefield Coastal Challenge 2026!** **SPECTATORS** Spectators are welcome and can attend for free! Bring your family and friends to support! ​ **VOLUNTEERING** Please note that **all competitors** are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). ​ **IMPORTANT NOTE ON VOLUNTEERING ASSIGNEMENTS** Please also check [Competition Groups](https://www.competitiongroups.com/) to see what groups you are in for competing as well as your running, judging and scrambling assignments. If you cannot make any of your assignments, it is **your** responsibility to find a replacement, and you must have a good reason for not being around for your assignment. Keep Competition Groups open during the day to ensure you never miss an assignment accidentally.

items.information: A inscrição é aberta a qualquer pessoa, de qualquer nacionalidade. Visando ao bom andamento da competição, ao se inscrever em uma categoria, você se compromete também a ajudar como juiz ou embaralhador nessa categoria (conforme previsto nas regras da WCA). Dessa forma, a competição se torna autossustentável, e as atividades são divididas entre todos os participantes, não ficando pesado para apenas alguns. Foram feitos pelo menos dois grupos em cada modalidade. Em um dos grupos você compete e no outro ajuda a embaralhar ou sendo juiz. **ATENÇÃO:** Para acessar o local do evento **será necessário informar o CPF e nome** tanto do competidor quanto de seus acompanhantes. Estes dados deverão ser incluídos na caixa de comentários, durante a inscrição. Inscrições sem estas informações não serão aceitas **ATENÇÃO:** Competidores menores de 16 anos devem estar acompanhadas por um responsável. Ressaltamos que a competição ocorrerá em um espaço público, e a organização não se responsabiliza pela supervisão das crianças. --- Registration is open to any person, from any country. With a view to the smooth running of the competition, by registering for a category, you also undertake to help as a judge or scrambler in that category (as provided for in the WCA rules). In this way, the competition becomes self-sustaining, and the activities are divided among all participants, not becoming heavy for just a few. At least two groups were made in each modality. In one of the groups you compete and in the other you help to scramble or judge. **ATTENTION:** To access the competition's venue it **will be required to inform an ID number** for both the competitor and their guests. This information must be included in the comment section of your registration. Registers without this data will not be accepted **ATTENTION:** Competitors under 16 must be accompanied by a guardian. Please note that the competition will take place in a public space, and the organization is not responsible for supervising children.

items.name: Wuppertaler Würfel Wochenende 2 2026
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTc0MTMyLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--9a458e6deff7a3097077605b82ba6ed6cb6f8495/60d4732d-5344-4eab-a473-19f2d1891969.png) **German** Liebe Cuberinnen und Cuber, wir freuen uns, euch zum 2. Wuppertaler Würfel-Wochenende 2026 am 24. und 25. Oktober 2026 einzuladen. Nach zwei erfolgreichen Ausgaben im Herbst 2025 und Frühjahr 2026 heißen wir euch erneut in Wuppertal zu einem offiziellen WCA-Wettbewerbswochenende willkommen. Teilnehmende aller Erfahrungsstufen sind herzlich eingeladen – ganz gleich, ob es eure erste Competition ist oder ihr bereits an vielen Wettbewerben teilgenommen habt. Wir freuen uns auf ein Wochenende mit offiziellen Solves, neuen persönlichen Bestzeiten und dem Austausch mit der Community. Bitte lest vor der Anmeldung alle Informationen auf der Wettbewerbsseite sorgfältig durch. Wir hoffen, euch in Wuppertal zu sehen! **English** Dear cubers, We are excited to invite you to the 2nd Wuppertal Cubing Weekend 2026 on October 24–25, 2026. Following two successful editions in autumn 2025 and spring 2026, we are once again delighted to welcome you to Wuppertal for an official WCA competition weekend. Participants of all experience levels are warmly invited to join—whether this is your very first competition or you have already attended many events. We look forward to a weekend of official solves, new personal bests, and connecting with the cubing community. Please make sure to read all information on the competition page carefully before registering. We hope to see you in Wuppertal!
